title: Production Support Analyst

Implement and support ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management). Participate in organizational and IT‑driven projects, contributing expertise in production operations. Drive continuous improvement with a focus on operational excellence and service quality. Qualifications: Experience working with or supporting ITIL processes. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work during off-hours as needed and handle production‑related urgency. Strong teamwork and a willingness to share knowledge with peers. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ability to work independently and collaboratively. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Strong desire and aptitude for learning new technologies. Demonstrated alignment with Cotiviti core values: Integrity, Client Focus, Teamwork, Accountability, Performance Excellence, and Continuous Improvement. Integrity Our Clients Our Team Accountability Performance Excellence Continuous Improvement MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 3 to 8 years of experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment. JOB DEMANDS: On‑call availability, including carrying a mobile device and responding during off-hours. Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. Flexibility to work evenings and weekends when required for deployments or critical support activities.
